rationale: Builds directly on the current best quant-aware int8 path and pivots to a new idea category: a minimal shared-weight recurrence transplant. The change reuses the last two MLP sublayers once more with learned per-channel gates, adding only tiny control tensors while keeping the existing final exact int8+zlib evaluation and endgame quantization logic intact. This targets better final roundtrip val_bpb through deeper late computation without a full architecture rewrite, and it stays safely under the 16MB artifact cap because the added parameters are negligible.
title: Gated Tail MLP Recurrence On Best Quant Path
